473:t_1:86.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Don't stop me, $$渓$$. This is the only way.」

473:t_1:87.en:
$$渓$$
「That doesn't make it right! If we just gave it more time, $$竜馬$$ might recover!」

473:t_1:88.en:
$$渓$$
「$$竜馬$$ has fought more than enough! And you're going to force him to recover just so he can fight again!?」

473:t_1:91.en:
$$弁慶$$
「If $$竜馬$$ could have made his own will known, he would have chosen this way.」

473:t_1:92.en:
$$隼人$$
「That's the kind of man he is.」

473:t_1:94.en:
$$隼人$$
「We're short on time. Let's hurry to a place where it won't affect the surroundings.」

473:t_1:97.en:
$$隼人$$
「But brace yourselves. From here on, things are surely going to move even faster.」

473:t_1:98.en:
$$隼人$$
「Anyone who fails to keep up with it might not survive...」

473:t_1:101.en:
$$號$$
「$$竜馬$$... Show me the power of your life force.」

473:t_2:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm not into guys clinging to me.」

473:t_2:8.en:
???
「Isn't it about time you accepted your mission?」

473:t_2:10.en:
???
「The battle that comes once every 120 million years... The battle against the Great Void is drawing near. Join us.」

473:t_2:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've got no obligation to take part in that.」

473:t_2:14.en:
???
「You are one who was chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$.」

473:t_2:17.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「We are the same as you.」

473:t_2:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$コーウェン$$! $$スティンガー$$!」

473:t_2:19.en:
???
「Ones enthralled by the void, I see.」

473:t_2:20.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「But we are also chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$.」

473:t_2:21.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Yes... In that sense, you and we are the same.」

473:t_2:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't lump us in with the Invaders, who evolved in a twisted way!」

473:t_2:23.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「I see... So you condemn anyone who walked a different path from your own as twisted.」

473:t_2:24.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「How is that any different from us?」

473:t_2:26.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「We will live... By destroying everything that gets in our way.」

473:t_2:27.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「To live is the fundamental meaning of a living thing... That is why we live...! We will live!」

473:t_2:28.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Anyone who blocks our path is an enemy!」

473:t_2:29.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Destroy your enemies, $$流竜馬$$! Walk the path of evolution with us!」

473:t_2:31.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Everything is your enemy! Fight, $$流竜馬$$!」

473:t_2:32.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Fighting is the meaning of your life! It is the path to evolution!」

473:t_2:43.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You jerk! Making us worry like that!!」

473:t_2:47.en:
$$弁慶$$
「What the hell are you saying!」

473:t_2:48.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$, don't tell me you...!!」

473:t_3:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...I caused everyone a lot of trouble this time. I'm sorry.」

473:t_3:6.en:
$$凱$$
「Come to think of it, that might be the first time I've seen it.」

473:t_3:7.en:
$$葵$$
「But he owed us at least that much.」

473:t_3:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Exactly. One wrong move, and someone on our side could have died.」

473:t_3:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I said I was sorry, didn't I!」

473:t_3:10.en:
$$チコ$$
「Is that any way to apologize, Mister?」

473:t_3:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$竜馬$$! At a time like this, you have to press your forehead to the floor and show how sorry you are with your whole body!」

473:t_3:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Go on...! Go on, go on!」

473:t_3:14.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Why don't you show him how it's done, $$アマタ$$?」

473:t_3:15.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Ha ha... $$ゼシカ$$ sure is harsh.」

473:t_3:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's enough, everyone. All's well that ends well, so let's leave it at that.」

473:t_3:18.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ah, the beautiful love between master and disciple!」

473:t_3:20.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$サザンカ$$, you stay out of this!」

473:t_3:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Thanks, $$甲児$$. If it weren't for you, $$ノノ$$ would've made me grovel on the floor.」
